course: Vienna type A/T1/sample1/r_v1 measured alternate-end AC waveform
release: CC BY 4.0; data collector Alessio Lampis and colleagues
terminal_chain: NI common acquisition 50kHz; bridge transverse load cells DC+AC, nut piezo AC. IWK Technical Report 1-2024 Fig6 uses centered wire-break and Newton reference weights. Relative gain/phase in a released processed stroke not independently certified. Compare recorded channels; no DC inference.
prior_exposure: First training member metadata classifier checked its numeric first line and 4-column shape. Shared compressed prefix and complete member CRC/SHA were authenticated before selection. No empirical reaction values shown. Positions and released classification-window indices are ancillary. Those published windows will not select the primary endpoint. No extraction of other specimens. First 56 samples occur in temporal acquisition order, hence date, tuning, force order, string state and bow position can covary.
source_stage_gate: Before selecting held reaction, require a detected 10 ms sustained |measured bow velocity| >= .02 m/s in at least two of three training pilot strokes, AC motion onset dynamic RMS above 3x pre-motion baseline or an explicitly diagnosed preloaded moving sequence, plus demonstrable transfer-band non-harmonic content. If source qualification fails, preserve refusal with held target sealed. Signed half-period control is unconditional; point law confers no additional ideal magnitude information exactly at nonnodal eigenfrequencies. Rig’s independent centered wire-break determines compatible orientation, but any recording-specific signed calibration fitted on source remains a predictive calibration.
physical_model: Rigid one-dimensional driven string, unknown distributed friction collapsed to single point, constant propagation speed nominal98 Hz over L, possible common propagation loss. Matched inputs for all roles are measured bridge channel, relative bow geometry and sample clock. Score complete untrimmed strokes using causal bandpass 25–800 Hz, 50 kHz acquisition. Do not identify physical supports, instrument filters, torsion, string stiffness/damping or contact-patch effects from the forecast.
evidence: One 14,083,546,513-byte Zenodo archive. Verified original archive directory CRC, member CRCs, per-member SHA, 128 MiB original packed prefix and separate16 MiB additional suffix. Publisher whole-file MD5 remains uncomputed.
salt: No shifting, scale fitting, phase correction or frequency selection on held nut. All arms frozen before held scoring, no held nut in predictor. Subsequent source-stage full algorithm and endpoint commit must precede held scientific values.
